Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Aarav - 9 years, son
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
2. Neeta - 34 years, mother
Look: pink kurta, a long plait
3. Vimla - 62 years, grandmother
Look: white saree, glasses
4. Ananya - 11 years, friend
Look: green salwar-kurta, short hair
5. Ayaan - 9 years, friend
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers

Places

1. The bedroom - a big bed, a wooden cupboard

Scene 1: The bedroom - Day

[Aarav stands in the bedroom. Neeta, Vimla and Ayaan stand near him.]

Vimla: "Ayaan, what's the plan today?"

[Aarav goes to bed and falls asleep.]

Neeta (excited): "Oh wow!"

[Aarav sits on the edge of the bed.]

Aarav: "I really enjoyed today."
